citation.title: Visualization and quantitation of GLUT4 translocation in human skeletal muscle following glucose ingestion and exercise

population.description: Experiment 2: ten healthy, lean, recreationally active men (abstract: 'a second cohort of ten age-, BMI- and VO2 max-matched insulin-sensitive men'; heights 1.83 m, body mass 75.3 kg). All insulin sensitive by fasting plasma glucose below 5.6 mmol/L and 2 h OGTT glucose below 7.8 mmol/L. Age 25 +/- 2 and BMI 22.6 +/- 0.5 are mean +/- SE (Table 1; Methods print SEM); SD computed as SE x sqrt(10) (6.32, 1.58). Experiment 1 (a different ten men) is entered as a per-protocol override.

protocols.name: exp2_ogtt
protocols.description: Experiment 2: 75 g glucose as a 25% solution ingested after an overnight fast (arrived 7 am; basal biopsy and blood sample, then the drink); blood at 0, 30, 60, 90 and 120 min after ingestion; biopsies at baseline, 30 and 60 min. Start hour 8.0 and 10 h fast assumed (arrival 7 am and a biopsy before the drink are stated, the clock at the drink is not).

protocols.name: exp1_ogtt
protocols.description: Experiment 1, visit 1: 75 g glucose as a 25% solution ingested after an overnight fast (arrived 7 am); blood before and 30, 60, 90 and 120 min after ingestion. Different ten participants from experiment 2. Start hour 8.0 and 10 h fast assumed.

protocols.name: exp1_exercise
protocols.description: Experiment 1, visit 2: overnight fasted (arrived 7 am), blood sample then basal biopsy (lidocaine), then 30 min cycling at a workload equivalent to 65% VO2 max; blood at baseline, after 15 and after 30 min of exercise. Intensity derived: group mean VO2 max 52.5 mL/min/kg (Table 1, experiment 1) x 0.65 = 34.125 mL/kg/min; level = (34.125 - 3.7)/31.7 = 0.960. Bout entered as minutes 0 to 31 so that the sample drawn after 30 min of exercise falls with the input on (the paper gives the bout as 30 min). Baseline blood sample drawn before the biopsy and the bout; the gap to the bout is not stated. Start hour 8.0 and 10 h fast assumed.
